parse_function_parse_frontmatter: parse YAML frontmatter from a markdown string and return the metadata dict and remaining body text
create_function_skill_matches_platform: check if a skill declared in frontmatter is compatible with the current operating system platform
create_function_get_disabled_skill_names: read disabled skill names from config.yaml for a given platform and return as a set
create_function_discover_all_skill_confi: scan all enabled skills and collect their config variable declarations into a deduplicated list
create_function_resolve_skill_config_val: resolve current values for skill config vars from config.yaml using declared defaults
